title: About us, our guides and drivers
description: A small Lahore company with guides and drivers from Hunza, Skardu and Swat. Meet the team, see how we run every trip, and how we keep your family safe on the road north.

header.headline: A Lahore company, with guides and drivers from the valleys we visit
header.lead: A small team in Lahore that plans every trip, and guides and drivers from the valleys we take you to.

image.alt: The Karakoram Highway curves past a guard rail and a stone wall towards snowy peaks half hidden in cloud

story.headline: Running trips north since {foundedYear}
paragraphs: We started with one hired coaster and a family from our own street in Lahore who wanted to see Hunza without worrying about the road. Most of the people we travel with live here, so Lahore is where we plan every trip and where every departure starts.

Within a few seasons, guides and drivers from Hunza, Skardu and Swat joined us. They taught us to plan around the weather and the roads rather than the clock, and to stop where the people who live there would stop.

We still do the same things on every trip: we message each family the night before, we never drive the mountain roads after dark, and we ask how it went once you’re home. It’s why so many families travel with us again, and bring their cousins next time.
